full_judgment: 2. The case of the petitioner, inter alia, is that he purchased 0.25 acres of land appertaining to SA Khatian No. 45, Plot Nos. 293/399/415 of Mouza Baroitala PS Patharghata District-Barguna at a consideration of Taka 4,800 from respondent No. 6 by kabala dated 21-5-1984 and respondent No.6 delivered possession of the land to the petitioner. The respondent Nos. 6 on 2-5-1991 filed an application under section 7 of Act 15 of 1989 to the Patharghata erstwhile Upazila now Thana Debt Settlement Board for cancellation or the said deed on the allegation, inter alia, that the transfer was made for the purpose of his maintenance and he did not own two acres of cultivable land and the property was sold at a lesser price than the market price and the petitioner at the time owned more than two acres of land. The petitioner filed written objection and denied the allegations made in the application and in the written objection it was specifically stated that the petitioner was owner of only .10 acre of land and the respondent No. 6 owned more than 2 acres of land at the time and the respondent did not make the transfer for his maintenance.
